title: pm-dispatch: an ADR amendment request appends a row to the week's "ADR revisions" card instead of filing its own card
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ③ maintainer-directed. Ruling-ref: the maintainer, 2026-11-20 ~04:0xZ, verbatim: 「adr接受你的建议」. ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读
- 要改什么：车队规则里「ADR 记录行归落地席位、合并后单独立卡」改成「追加到本周 ADR 修订清单卡」。
- 为什么：少立卡、少要你批准；ADR 修订一周一个 PR。
- 不改会怎样：每条 ADR 修订仍各立一卡、各要你批一次。
- 要你做什么：无（规则改动按车队规则走审批）。

## Change
- Where the skill tells a landing seat to file an ADR record or amendment card after a merge (`execution-duties.md`, the ADR record line; the `Skills-docs`/ADR bookkeeping passages in pm-dispatch), say instead: append one row to the open "ADR revisions, week of …" card (ADR, section, what it says, what is true now, the landing PR); open next week's card if none is open.
- Only ADR text that disagrees with `main` is collected. A pure addition that contradicts nothing is not filed at all.
- Triage's first touch closes a new single ADR-amendment card by moving its row onto the week's card.
- The rolling card lands as one governed `docs/adr/**` PR per week.

First card under this rule: the "ADR revisions, week of 2026-11-20" card filed beside this one.
